QF.id: AIFM CIII Fee Structure and Fund Performance_16

question.text: Kaveri Macro Fund has a total initial set-up cost of INR 2.4 crore (incl. GST), amortised over the 4-year fund tenure. What is the annual set-up cost charged to NAV?

explanation.text: The Logic: Annual amortisation = INR 2.4 cr / 4 = INR 60 lakh per year. Set-up costs are capped at 1.5–2.5% of corpus per SEBI norms and amortised over 36 months (or life) per PPM. The Trap: INR 48 lakh assumes 5-year life. INR 240 lakh treats full amount in year 1. INR 6 lakh is per-month not per-year. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-D Cat I/II Manager uses similar amortisation rules; XIX-E Cat III tests it numerically. Manager's Pro-Tip: Negotiate the set-up cost CAP with LPs in the side letter — rogue placement-agent fees can balloon set-up above 2% if no cap is agreed.
